configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Ninja single-configuration optimized build of the library, the tools, the examples, the benchmarks, and the test suites into build/release. Configure from a developer environment that provides the toolchain (for the MSVC toolset: vcvars64.bat).

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Ninja single-configuration debug build of the library, the tools, the examples, the benchmarks, and the test suites into build/debug.

configurePresets.name: analyze
configurePresets.description: Ninja single-configuration build with the MSVC static analyzer enabled on first-party code (/analyze). Platform and standard-library headers are declared external so that only first-party findings are reported. Warnings-as-errors is off for this diagnostic configuration: the analyzer reports C6101 from the Windows SDK header ws2tcpip.h (included by src/socket.cpp) through the translation unit, which /external:W0 does not suppress, so /WX would stop the analysis run instead of reporting findings. The release and debug presets keep warnings-as-errors on.

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: Ninja single-configuration build with MSVC AddressSanitizer instrumentation (/fsanitize=address /Zi) and incremental linking disabled, which AddressSanitizer requires.

testPresets.name: release
testPresets.description: Runs the ctest test registered by tests/CMakeLists.txt against the Release build.

testPresets.name: debug
testPresets.description: Runs the ctest test registered by tests/CMakeLists.txt against the Debug build.

testPresets.name: analyze
testPresets.description: Runs the ctest test registered by tests/CMakeLists.txt against the static-analysis build.

testPresets.name: asan
testPresets.description: Runs the ctest test registered by tests/CMakeLists.txt under AddressSanitizer.
